extraction_notes.note: Borel-Serre's result is stated in full but inside the same sentence as the paper's conclusion that L_{2k}->MU(k) is an equivalence modulo torsion; a sentence cannot be split, so it is one paper claim with Borel-Serre as an assumption.
The Cartan-Leray spectral sequence statement shares its sentence with a remark on the cofiber killing the H_*(k!) summand; kept as one external theorem node.
Uncited standard facts (complex orientation gives an FGL; MU(k) as cofiber, which the paper calls 'surely well-known') marked external standard (uncited); could be read as paper content.

Proofs are informal prose; PP3 includes the strategy paragraphs before the 'We therefore claim' lemma. In Section 6 the argued result (square is a pullback) is announced before its argument, and the final R_k ~ W^k CP is kept in the proof.
Much content is commutative diagrams (xymatrix) and figure captions; the two figure captions are taken as examples of blooms, the diagram-only summary as a remark.

The negative observation that S^{2k-1}*F_k is not highly connected is a claim; its justifying sentence (induction on flag manifolds, pi_1 F_k = k!) is a one-sentence proof node, although it also states new facts.

Sentences end in displayed diagrams with no closing punctuation, and the figure examples exist only as captions; these spans end at the display or caption end, which the checker flags as mid-sentence.
Historical/expository remarks (Betley quotation, Steiner isoperimetric parallel, motivation sentences, the prose restatement of Lemma 1 and the sentence previewing Lemma 2) were not made nodes.
